links.outcome: Omission of critical contraindications and guideline currency in LLM pharmacy answers
links.effect: 75% of models omitted critical contraindications (eg, ethambutol in optic neuritis); 90% erroneously recommended macrolides for drug-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae; only DeepSeek-R1 aligned with updated AAP guidelines for pediatric doxycycline.
links.quote: Critical limitations were observed across models, including high-risk decision errors-75% omitted critical contraindications (eg, ethambutol in optic neuritis) and a lack of localization-90% erroneously recommended macrolides for drug-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae (China's high-resistance setting), while only DeepSeek-R1 aligned with updated American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) guidelines for pediatric doxycycline.

links.outcome: Detection of prescription limits and implausible prescriptions in prescription review
links.effect: No model identified diazepam's 7-day prescription limit; only Claude-3.5-Sonnet detected a gender-diagnosis contradiction (prostatic hyperplasia in female).
links.quote: Complex reasoning deficits: only Claude-3.5-Sonnet detected a gender-diagnosis contradiction (prostatic hyperplasia in female); no model identified diazepam's 7-day prescription limit.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking of 8 commercial LLMs across 48 clinical pharmacy scenarios scored by expert pharmacists for accuracy and safety deficits, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
